description: Customer enquiry emails and attachments with the MaterialSpec a correct extractor must produce.

changelog.change: First case: legacy DIN grade St37-2 normalises to S235JR.

Added 8 hard cases (llm-drafted, unverified): German decimal comma and exonym, Polish units and declined city, ambiguous grade S355, missing incoterm and date, German thousands dot in kg, Excel-only order, prompt injection, relative date.
Added en-006: subject and body give different quantities, so quantity must stay empty (finding F-008); prompt v2 reports conflicts.
Finding F-011 (owner: DIN convention): generic Blech/blacha is sheet under 3 mm and plate from 3 mm. Added de-004 (Blech, 15 mm: plate). pl-001 relabelled: blacha at 4 mm is plate, not sheet.

Reasons rewritten in plain words; finding and decision codes moved to the new references field. Owner instruction (2026-10-11): 5 of 11 cases marked verified (at least 40%). Chosen by Claude to cover every risk, language and outcome, including known failures; counterfactual groups are verified whole. Labels were not re-reviewed case by case.
